problems.reason: Sentences 10 and 11 give conflicting time ranges for Polacanthus’s existence (130–125 Ma vs. 124–132 Ma), which do not overlap consistently and present contradictory age estimates.

notes: - contradiction: "Polacanthus was an extinct genus of ankylosaurian dinosaurs that lived in England during the Early Cretaceous period, approximately 130 to 125 million years ago." / "Polacanthus lived during the Barremian age, approximately 124 to 132 million years ago.": Sentences 10 and 11 give conflicting time ranges for Polacanthus’s existence (130–125 Ma vs. 124–132 Ma), which do not overlap consistently and present contradictory age estimates.
